_about: Public-domain George Stanhope (1660-1728), Dean of Canterbury, for the Word Hoard: A Paraphrase and Comment upon the Epistles and Gospels (London 1726, four volumes) and his Sermons preached upon several occasions (1705), from Internet Archive scans of Eighteenth Century Collections Online. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 45 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

stanhope-paraphrase-1: A Paraphrase and Comment upon the Epistles and Gospels, vol. 1 (London, catalogued 1726)
stanhope-paraphrase-2: A Paraphrase and Comment upon the Epistles and Gospels, vol. 2 (London, catalogued 1726)
stanhope-paraphrase-3: A Paraphrase and Comment upon the Epistles and Gospels, vol. 3 (London, catalogued 1726)
stanhope-paraphrase-4: A Paraphrase and Comment upon the Epistles and Gospels, vol. 4 (London, catalogued 1726)
stanhope-sermons-1705: Sermons preach'd upon several occasions (London, catalogued 1705)

_excluded.stanhope-translations: His English versions of Thomas a Kempis, Charron, Epictetus, Augustine's Meditations and Andrewes's Devotions: other men's works
